description: Why does passive third-person observation fail to produce genuine understanding? In this episode, we unpack the epistemological failure behind Wang Yangming's famous "bamboo investigation"—staring at a bamboo stalk for seven days expecting universal principles to automatically emerge—and reveal the true mechanics of Gewu Zhizhi (investigating things to extend knowledge). We explore the vast, unbridgeable complexity gap between human information and physical reality. All human knowledge, models,…
classificationReason: 核心讨论具身因果模拟、物理约束和从观察到行动的理解，偏理论而非具体机器人系统。
qualityReason: 围绕明确论题展开深度概念分析，并列出具体讨论框架与参考文章。
